steps: Enroll in a beginner Photoshop course on Skillshare or Coursera to start photo-editing.
Practice Lightroom by editing 10 photos from free stock sites using online tutorials.
Complete a DSLR basics workshop (local or online) to master manual settings.
Build a portfolio of 5 edited photos and share on Instagram to practice brand expression.
Take an Adobe Creative Suite overview course to integrate tools like InDesign and Premiere.
